crossRefs.note: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
This is the word that Yahweh has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed…

translations.web: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
translations.bsb: Yet when she proudly spreads her wings, she laughs at the horse and its rider.
translations.kjv: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
translations.asv: What time she lifteth up herself on high, She scorneth the horse and his rider.
